title: env.yaml
description: An env.yaml file describes the referee and available agents.

referee.description: The referee to use. For now, it is the name of a jar file in the referees directory.

src.description: Project entry point or source code.

win_bin.description: Path to a Windows executable (.exe). If the agent must run in a Windows system, this binary will be used.

linux_bin.description: Path to a Linux executable. If the agent must run in a Linux system, this binary will be used.

params.description: Parameters to pass to the agent. If the parameter is not recognized by the agent, no error/warning will be shown.

additionalProperties.description: An arbitrary parameter, it MUST match the type of parameter that the agent expects. No error/warning will be shown.

oneOf.$comment: src can only be used if no binaries are provided.
At least one binary must be provided.
